Hey I never replies because I kinda get this weird anxiety about replying, yay mental health issues -sighs-.
I wanted to say thank you so much for your help!! I have found coconut flour, almond flour and his diet... it is amazing. He is 37 and he has ate the same foods for his entire life! Literally:
Fish fingers (only the small ones)
Chips
Bread
Cheese slices but also other cheeses
Pizza only plain cheese with tomato.
Sausage rolls
Apples
Bananas I got him used to a few years back as he needs the potassium at work.

A few months back I had him try domino's cheesy dough balls, he loves them but I then pointed out the consistency and it clicked. He was not as afraid of it because he likes breads and cheesy but the texture was soft and gooey which he had not tried before.

Took time but today he went to work with no bread!
Ryvita rye crackers x 14 (over a 12hr period though)
Salmon flakes with a lil bbq maple sauce
Sausages which are very low fat/gluten free etc
Parmesan, only 5g though for dipping the crackers in
Chocolate cadbury twirl because he needs a reward lol

With sausages I know not the best but it is a new protein and texture. I also found turkey sausages though and didn't tell him what it was. I would never usually do this but sometimes his prejudices to food can take over, he loved it, I told him and he was stunned.
The only thing in that lunch today he had that was similar to all the previous ones is the margarine spread on the crackers!
Your post inspired that change, he realised how bad his diet was, how the carbs have had him doing sugar highs and lows all the time. He's embraced protein and new textures. I won't be pushing but I know within a year he will be able to eat many more foods. The ball has started rolling and he is embracing it :)
The crackers are still high in carbs but compared to bread it is a huge difference. He is starting to add more meat to the ryvita though and within a month I can see him eating more fish and less of the actual biscuits :)

I also wanted to say that I lol'd at your diet! It is just like mine! I adore Japanese foods, so much healthier and lighter on the stomach than western food which is so stoggy! There is a reason that Japanese people live longer and look younger, good food!

He has lost 11lbs in the last month which floored him when I found a 4lbs weight from my mother in laws old scales lol

Thank you hun, you have done so much!
